title: fix(imap): use try_from for i64→u32 UIDVALIDITY casts
description: mailbox.rs casts i64 values from SQLite to u32 with silent truncation (as u32) at lines 177, 224, and 250. The stored values always fit u32 in practice (UIDVALIDITY is a Unix timestamp in seconds; next_uid increments slowly). However as u32 is silent on overflow — if a database corruption or migration error introduced a value > u32::MAX, the IMAP client would receive wrong UIDVALIDITY/UIDNEXT values with no operator indication. RFC 3501 requires UIDVALIDITY must never change; a silently wrong value breaks client sync. Fix: use u32::try_from with a warn! + fallback to 1.
